source_level_checks.conclusion: F=|det E_s|^(1/2) is a real-positive dynamical half-density factor, complexified when needed, and is not the Hermitian prequantum line bundle. On the symplectization Sigma the exact symplectic form permits a trivial prequantum bundle; its connection can still have nonzero curvature. The 2007 paper explicitly uses curvature +i*omega/hbar with omega=dq wedge dp and D=d+i*eta/hbar in the reference frame. A different sign/2pi convention must be declared together with the connection and symplectic form; topology-trivial does not mean flat.
source_level_checks.local_boundary: No local page defines a prequantum connection or claims a curvature formula. The auxiliary +i curvature convention is checked but is not imported as the site's d(lambda) convention. Torus integrality and global lift existence were not certified.

source_level_checks.conclusion: Use smooth closed manifolds, a smooth contact Reeb flow and uniform hyperbolicity. Negative sectional curvature is a sufficient geodesic hypothesis, not the definition of Anosov. General Anosov resonance discreteness does not alone imply contact band structure or mixing. E_s and E_u are generally only Holder transverse to the flow.

Koopman evolution preserves the Liouville L2 norm. Decaying resonances belong to suitable anisotropic distribution spaces, with an unbounded closed generator and spectral windows depending on the weight. Resolvent norms are not independent of that space. SIAM (5.6) corrects v1 by explicitly completing C-infinity in the ||W T u|| norm.

Band confinement is high-frequency, in Re(z)>-C with adapted anisotropic spaces, and permits finitely many low-frequency exceptions. Distinct bands need not be disjoint. Bounded first-band projector and exponentially smaller remainder require gamma_1^+<gamma_0^- and a contour avoiding low eigenvalues. The projector is fixed only up to a finite-rank choice at low frequencies. For a fixed claimed remainder exponent, the final page binds the cut to a < gamma_{k+1}^+ + epsilon and includes every low generalized mode to its right; an arbitrary finite-rank reassignment can change that exponent.

The metaplectic tangential factor is unitary in its linear-model L2 realization. Global quantization is an effective high-frequency description with cutoffs/remainders; concentration of resonance real parts at zero is not exact unitarity. For a hyperbolic surface the shifted oscillatory branch corresponds to +/-i sqrt(Delta-1/4), with low eigenvalues, threshold and other exceptional resonances treated separately. A rank-one normal fiber does not make the global band finite-dimensional.

The Casimir calculation is a conditional necessary relation, not a full spectral correspondence proof. Flat trace is distributional for t>0. The source's section 5 is explicitly a proof summary. Born's rule and a deterministic foundation of physical quantum mechanics remain interpretive questions, not proved consequences.

site_convention.local_comparison: For identically ordered canonical coordinates, omega_cat=-Omega_site, hence +i omega_cat/hbar=-i Omega_site/hbar. A bare curvature sign without the symplectic and connection conventions is not a meaningful discrepancy.

prequantum_convention_audit.independent_geometry: Sigma has exact symplectic form d(omega alpha), so a topologically trivial complex line can carry a nonflat connection with the required proportional curvature. Trivial bundle does not mean zero curvature. This is distinct from |det E_s|^(1/2) and from metaplectic double-cover data.
prequantum_convention_audit.hilbert_space_distinction: Prequantum L2 sections on the cat-map phase space are infinite-dimensional; its finite-dimensional polarized quantum space is a different construction. Neither is silently identified with an anisotropic PR band space in these notes.
prequantum_convention_audit.not_certified: Torus integrality, global lift existence, holonomy conventions outside the explicitly read formulas, or a full geometric-quantization construction.
